verdict.rationale: As a physical GPU card, the RTX PRO 6000 is inherently self-hosted hardware; NVIDIA's docs explicitly market it for running LLMs and autonomous AI agents 'locally and securely' and accelerating data science 'without relying on costly cloud or data center resources.' Community hands-on evidence corroborates real self-hosted multi-GPU deployments (four cards achieving 41k tok/s locally), confirming the capability works in practice. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark or security audit specifically validating the 'secure local hosting' claim beyond marketing language.
